contactMessageLine1: Members of the public wishing to observe a hearing or representatives of the media may, on their request, join any video hearing remotely while they are taking place by sending an email in advance to the tribunal at [insert office email] with the following details in the subject line “[OBSERVER/MEDIA] REQUEST – [case reference] – [hearing date]” and appropriate arrangements will be made to allow access where reasonably practicable.
contactMessageLine2: Listings often change at short notice, and therefore if you wish to observe a hearing, you may wish to contact the office first to check it is proceeding.
observationText: Observe a court or tribunal hearing as a journalist, researcher or member of the public
